madeToMeasure.metaDescription: Every dress in the collection can be made to your measurements in our Prizren atelier. We guide you one measurement at a time and ship worldwide.
madeToMeasure.label: Made to measure
title: Your Measurements.
Your Dress.
madeToMeasure.intro: In a standard size, your body adapts to the dress. Here it is the other way round: the dress is cut and sewn to you, by hand, in Prizren.
madeToMeasure.measureText: The guide asks for one measurement per screen, each with an illustration and a short instruction. You choose centimetres or inches once. If a value looks unusual, we ask before you continue.
madeToMeasure.extraText: For dresses with sleeves or a fitted bodice, the guide adds only the measurements that design needs.
tips: Use a soft tailor's tape, not a builder's measure.
Measure over light underwear, not thick clothing.
Keep the tape flat and snug, never tight.
If you can, ask someone to help.
For lengths to the floor, wear the shoes you will wear.
madeToMeasure.timeText: The making time is shown on each dress. It ships as soon as it's finished, and delivery time counts from then.

faq.metaDescription: Answers about sizing, made to measure dresses, making time, worldwide shipping, payment and returns at Jela Fashion.
faq.label: Help
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Write to us and we'll answer personally.

items.q: How do I choose my size?
items.a: Compare your measurements with the size guide. If you're between two sizes or outside the chart, choose Custom size and the dress is made to you.
Once you choose the dress, the guide asks for your measurements one at a time, with an illustration for each. They're saved with your order and the atelier reviews them before work begins.

items.q: What if I get a measurement wrong?
items.a: The guide warns you when a value looks unusual. If you have doubts after ordering, write to us as soon as possible with your order number.

items.q: How long does a dress take?
items.a: The making time is shown on each dress. Dresses in stock ship soon after payment; made-to-order and custom dresses ship as soon as they're finished.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
Can I talk to someone before ordering?
items.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp or ask for a video consultation, and we'll help you with your size or choosing a dress.
Worldwide. The rate and delivery time depend on the country and are shown at checkout and on the shipping page.
By card through Paysera, by bank transfer, through Western Union, MoneyGram or Ria, or with Wise. For payments without a card, the details appear after you order and you can upload your receipt.
The full conditions are on the returns page, including those for dresses made to your measurements.

privacy.metaDescription: How Jela Fashion collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy policy.
privacy.intro: This page explains which personal data we collect when you use this site, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who we are
body: The controller of your data is [COMPANY LEGAL NAME], [STREET ADDRESS], Prizren, Kosovo, business number [BUSINESS NUMBER]. Contact: [EMAIL].

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you order: your name, email, phone, delivery and billing addresses, the dresses you chose and, for custom sizes, your body measurements and notes.
When you pay without a card: the proof of payment you upload, the reference and the sender's name. Card payments are handled by Paysera; we never see your card details.
When you create an account: your email and, if you add them, your name, phone, saved addresses and measurement profiles.
When you write to us or subscribe to the newsletter: your message, contact details and language.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To make and deliver your order, to confirm payments, to answer your questions and, only if you agreed, to send you the newsletter. With your consent, and only then, we measure visits (Google Analytics) and ad performance (Meta, TikTok).

sections.title: Who processes it for us
body: Supabase (database and file storage, EU region), Vercel (hosting), Resend (email), Paysera (card payments) and, with your consent, Google, Meta and TikTok. Each processes data only to provide its service.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: [RETENTION PERIODS]

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to its use, or withdraw consent at any time, by writing to [EMAIL]. You can change your cookie choices at any time on the cookie page.
